name: Carriage House Cocktails
notes: Karaoke/dive bar (4690 Convoy St, San Diego). Extensive search (own Facebook page, beermenus.com listing, Yelp, sandiego.org, restaurant.com, multiple directories) found no priced food or drink menu anywhere. Beermenus lists the venue but no beers or prices. Coverage describes it as bring-your-own-food-allowed with occasional free grilled snacks and BBQ specials (Sun 1pm, Tue 4pm), not a priced menu. Drink-only/karaoke dive bar publishing no per-item prices.
